#🇬🇧
This competition awards the 2026 titles for 4x4 blindfolded, 5x5 blindfolded and multi-blind.

###The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for the Italian Quiet Championship 2026 in Milan.###
Due to the small size of the venue, we would like to give Italian citizens the best opportunity to fight for the national titles. Due to reasons out of our control Italy has held fewer competitions than usual in 2026. We wish to see you when we get back up to speed in 2027!
